The Islamist group Al-Shabaab, a branch of al-Quaeda, claimed responsibility for the attack. On 23rd September, the siege was ongoing. On 24th, the President of Kenya announced the end of the assault and said the perpetrators (about 15)…
records.name: Terrorist Attack Westgate Shopping Mail Nairobi

The massive fireball that ensued killed at least 54 people and wounded 82 people.  The fire quickly spread over 1/2 mile and destroyed or damaged homes in its path.
The town in Babil Province is about 35 miles south of Baghdad.
records.name: Iraq Mosque Bombed
